title: 12 Best Craft Beer Bars in Ho Chi Minh City — The Unfiltered Guide
description: The best craft beer bars in Ho Chi Minh City — curated from Reddit reviews. Heart of Darkness, Pasteur Street, East West Brewing, BiaCraft, 7 Bridges & more. Taproom guides, IPA picks, and honest verdicts.

places.name: Heart of Darkness Craft Brewery
places.address: 31D Lý Tự Trọng, Bến Nghé, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: I'm here for 5 days in Saigon. Craft beer lover, especially of IPAs. Been to Heart of Darkness brewery (quite good) and curious to know if there's any other must-visits.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CraftBeer · Craft breweries in Ho Chi Minh City thread

redditQuotes.text: Heart of Darkness is my personal favourite in Saigon where I found myself celebrating my birthday, working on my laptop with my favourite IPA by my side, having lunch and meeting friends. Somehow all roads led me there.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

redditQuotes.text: Pasteur Street Craft Beer Ngô Thời Nhiệm — Premium Local Craft Beer in HCMC. 5/5 ⭐ — A Must-Visit for Craft Beer Lovers in Saigon!
redditQuotes.source: — Facebook Vietnam Travel Guide · Craft Beer Recommendation thread, 2025

redditQuotes.text: Pasteur Street is worth a visit. The original taproom on Pasteur Street with the small roof terrace tucked away in an inner courtyard is the perfect place to enjoy their hop-heavy Jasmine IPA.
redditQuotes.source: — r/VietNam · Bar recommendations in Ho Chi Minh thread

places.name: East West Brewing Co.
places.address: 181 Lý Tự Trọng, Bến Thành, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: East West Brewing Company — their Coffee Vanilla Porter is a firm favorite of fellow patrons. In fact, it just might be best to get a Beer Flight so that you can sample all of their delicious brews!
redditQuotes.source: — JetsettingFools · 4 Outstanding Saigon Craft Breweries guide

redditQuotes.text: Bia Craft in D2 was the spot to be when I was last there, though Pasteur Street is worth a visit.
redditQuotes.source: — r/CraftBeer · 14 different kinds of craft beer in Vietnam thread

redditQuotes.text: BiaCraft prides itself for the most extensive craft beer offer in the city. The salted egg yolk cheesecake blew us away so we ordered a second piece straight away and returned for more many times since.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

places.name: 7 Bridges Craft Beer
places.address: 15B/12 Lê Thánh Tôn, Bến Nghé, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: 7 Bridges was an experimental start up that took the craft beer scene in Vietnam by storm. Established in 2017, they were winning awards and accolades by 2018.

places.name: Belgo Belgian Craft Beer & Restaurant
places.address: 159A Nguyễn Văn Thủ, Đa Kao, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: Belgo: Belgian Craft Brewery — dedicated to creating classic Belgium-style craft beer in HCMC, a hip gastropub with a good happy hour.
redditQuotes.source: — PaleAleTravel · 5 Breweries to Check Out in Ho Chi Minh City

places.name: C-Brewmaster
places.address: 12/4C Nguyễn Thị Minh Khai, Đa Kao, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: C-Brewmaster's pho beer — it's a light, thirst-quenching beer with hints of various herbs normally found in pho. Despite sounding off-putting, it does go down really well on humid afternoons.
redditQuotes.source: — amatteroftaste.me · Craft Beer Bars in Saigon guide

places.name: Rooster Beers Taproom
places.address: 40 Bùi Viện, Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: The Chicken Coop and Tiệm Bia Gà Rooster Beers Taproom are two places on Bùi Viện that serve a pretty decent selection of craft beer.

places.name: Winking Seal Beer Co.
places.address: 50 Đặng Thị Nhu, Phường Nguyễn Thái Bình, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: Saigon craft breweries: East West Brewing Company, Heart of Darkness Brewery, Pasteur Street Brewing Company, Winking Seal Beer Co.
redditQuotes.source: — RamblingFeet · 4 Outstanding Saigon Craft Breweries in District 1

places.name: Hop CraftBeer
places.address: 207 Bùi Viện, Phường Phạm Ngũ Lão, Quận 1

redditQuotes.text: Hop CraftBeer is a welcome addition to Bùi Viện. They pour 3T Brewing on draft and carry bottles and cans from the other popular craft breweries in Saigon.

places.name: Bột Craft Beers Rooftop
places.address: 23 Nguyễn Hữu Cảnh, Phường 22, Bình Thạnh

redditQuotes.text: If you're staying in Ho Chi Minh City, come by Bột Craft Beers.
redditQuotes.source: — r/VietNam · Craftbeer scene in VN thread

redditQuotes.text: 4P's offers a rotating range of craft beers that pair nicely with their in-house made cheese!
